text:
chandra: Heads up — CI longseq-inference started failing after merge of PR #2987 (kv-prefetch scheduling + kernel deprioritize). Seeing OOMs on several 12GB hosts. dashboard: https://perf.redwood.internal/d/longseq/overview

ci-bot: CI job longseq-inference (linux-gpu) failed on 4/10 machines with OOM during token generation. Logs uploaded: https://ci.redwood/internal/2987/longseq/failures

dina: repro steps please? is this purely CI or customers too?

chandra: quick repro I used locally: `./run_inference_bench --model redwood-xl-8k --seq 8192 --batch 8 --workload long-context --iter 100`
env: `KV_PREFETCH=1 KERNEL_DEPRIORITIZE_HEAPLETS=1`

chandra: failing log snippet:```
2026-03-18T09:12:03Z ERROR runtime::alloc OOM while reserving heaplet (wanted=128MB)
  slab:0x7f9c2ef10000 free=42MB used=10GB
  kv_frag_ratio=0.63 seqlen=8192 batches_inflight=6
```

ben: starting bisect now across the merge window for PR #2987. initial suspects: commit `abcdef1` (heaplet scheduler change) and `bcdefa2` (batching->prefetch hook). will post intermediate results.

eli: quick perf snapshot from a failing canary:
```
kv_lookup_hotpath  42%  (increased from 12%)
mm_churn           18%  (++ mapped/unmap)
evict_scan         12%  (more frequent)
```
looks like more scanning + mmap churn on long ctx workloads.

alice: suggestion: flip `KV_PREFETCH=0` and hold rollout for #2987. if bisect points to `abcdef1` we should revert asap.

chandra: agree. question is whether prefetch puts small hot chunks into places that deprioritize adjacent heaplets (fragmentation), or deprioritization itself prevents compaction -> thrash.

ben: bisect update: narrowing down to `abcdef1` — heaplet scheduling tweak that deprioritizes 'small hot chunk' heaplets during kernel selection. hypothesis: it increases free-run fragmentation for long sequences.

alice: I'll open a revert PR for `abcdef1` and queue a hotfix canary. PR #3010 created: https://git.redwood/reverts/3010. removing the deprioritization change.

dina: setting rollout HOLD for the upstream merge and notifying oncall. @alice please also set canary=false in the deploy config.

alice: done — canary toggled off and rollback queued.

chandra: immediate mitigations:
- disable kv prefetch (KV_PREFETCH=0) for canary and CI longseq job
- temporarily increase host mem threshold / autoscale to avoid customer OOMs

ben: reverted commit applied to a canary cluster and running the longseq regression job now.

ci-bot: Re-run CI with revert PR #3010 -> longseq tests: 10/10 machines passed :white_check_mark: (previously 6/10).

dina: will coordinate a hotfix rollout for prod tenants that saw errors.

chandra: action items post-hotfix: add regression test for seqlen >= 6000, expose kv fragmentation histogram, and add a nightly canary job that runs long-context profiles. owners: chandra + ben.

eli: also add a microbenchmark that simulates interleaved prefetch+batching to catch this class earlier.

chandra: thanks everyone. we'll collect heaplet histograms from the failed runs and include in postmortem. opening incident ticket and will post follow-up notes there.
